hardConstraints: Use SF Pro or a close system fallback for labels, UI text, metrics, and explanatory copy.
Use Recoleta or a close editorial serif fallback only for key headlines, brand moments, and the final principle scene.
No flicker, blank flash frames, or abrupt pop-in unless storyboarded.
No exaggerated AI magic beams, sweeps, or glow effects.
allowedOptimizations: Refine spacing rhythm and negative space to improve scanability.
Use subtle dot-grid or halftone structure when it supports composition.
Vary stagger timing to keep motion alive without adding clutter.
prohibitedDeviations: Do not drift from the Lucius brand palette.
Do not use serif typography for body text or dense UI labels.
Do not create multiple competing focal points in a single scene.
Do not place logos with shadows, outlines, stretching, or low contrast.
layoutRules: One primary reading path per scene.
Use generous negative space and card spacing.
Keep Discord and Lucius iconography integrated into one visual system.
motionRules: Motion should be calm, deliberate, and readable.
Supporting motion should not compete with the focal path.
typeRules: Sans for UI, metrics, and operational text.
Serif only for deliberate editorial emphasis.
colorRules: Warm Ivory and soft white should dominate the field.
Lucius Purple and Deep Moss should act as signal colors.
